# wdauto

`wdauto` prepares and starts the local WebDriver service used by
[tidypptsdd](https://github.com/tony2015116/tidypptsdd) to download
reports through Chrome or Edge. It runs on x86 and x64 Windows with R
4.1 or newer and the selected browser installed. Chrome runs through
ChromeDriver with `backend = "chromedriver"` (no Java needed, used by
tidypptsdd), or through Selenium Server 3.141.59 on Java for RSelenium
clients (the default). Edge uses Microsoft Edge WebDriver directly.

[Get started](https://tony2015116.github.io/wdauto/articles/wdauto.html)
·
[中文使用说明](https://tony2015116.github.io/wdauto/articles/wdauto-zh.html)
· [Cheatsheet](https://tony2015116.github.io/wdauto/cheatsheet.html) ·
[速查表](https://tony2015116.github.io/wdauto/cheatsheet-zh.html)

## Installation

``` r

install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("tony2015116/wdauto")
```

## Start or reuse Chrome

``` r

library(wdauto)

driver_dir <- "C:/webdriver"
get_cd(driver_dir)
get_ss(driver_dir)
auto_cs(driver_dir)
```

[`get_cd()`](https://tony2015116.github.io/wdauto/reference/get_cd.md)
matches the installed Chrome milestone and Windows platform and reuses a
cached driver without network access.
[`get_ss()`](https://tony2015116.github.io/wdauto/reference/get_ss.md)
prepares the Selenium 3.141.59 standalone server, which accepts the
legacy JSON Wire protocol used by RSelenium.
[`auto_cs()`](https://tony2015116.github.io/wdauto/reference/auto_cs.md)
waits for the service at `127.0.0.1:4444/wd/hub` to accept connections.
Repeated calls reuse the running managed service.

Clients that speak the W3C protocol can skip Java and Selenium:

``` r

get_cd(driver_dir)
auto_cs(driver_dir, backend = "chromedriver")
```

ChromeDriver then serves the same address, `127.0.0.1:4444/wd/hub`.

## Start or reuse Edge

``` r

get_cd(driver_dir, browser = "edge")
auto_cs(driver_dir, browser = "edge")
```

Edge uses a separate service at `127.0.0.1:4445` and its own login
startup entry. Select Edge in both the startup and download calls in
tidypptsdd.

## Downloads in mainland China or offline

Driver and Selenium downloads try a mirror first and fall back to the
official servers:

``` r

options(wdauto.mirror = "npmmirror")   # or Sys.setenv(WDAUTO_MIRROR = "npmmirror")
get_cd(driver_dir)
```

Any other mirror can be given as URL prefix replacements, for example
`options(wdauto.mirror = c("https://storage.googleapis.com/chrome-for-testing-public" = "https://my.mirror/cft"))`.
The option in effect when
[`auto_cs()`](https://tony2015116.github.io/wdauto/reference/auto_cs.md)
writes the startup entry is reused at login. Without network access,
install archives that were downloaded on another computer:

``` r

get_cd(driver_dir, zip = "chromedriver-win64.zip")
get_ss(driver_dir, jar = "selenium-server-standalone-3.141.59.jar")
```

## Login startup and browser updates

By default
[`auto_cs()`](https://tony2015116.github.io/wdauto/reference/auto_cs.md)
installs or updates a hidden login startup entry (`wdauto_chrome.vbs` or
`wdauto_edge.vbs` in the current user’s Startup folder). Pass
`autostart = FALSE` for a one-time start. At login the driver is
resolved again and the start is retried for about two minutes while the
network comes up. Entries written by earlier wdauto releases are
replaced.

When the browser updates while the service is running, the next
[`auto_cs()`](https://tony2015116.github.io/wdauto/reference/auto_cs.md)
call restarts the service with the new driver if no session is open.
Pass `restart = "never"` to get an error instead.

## Stop or troubleshoot the service

Run
[`reset_cs()`](https://tony2015116.github.io/wdauto/reference/reset_cs.md)
to stop the managed service and remove its login startup entry for
Chrome. For Edge, use `reset_cs(browser = "edge")`.
[`reset_cs()`](https://tony2015116.github.io/wdauto/reference/reset_cs.md)
still removes the startup entry when the process record is damaged.

The service logs are in `%LOCALAPPDATA%/wdauto/webdriver-*/`; the five
newest are kept. The login launcher writes to
`%LOCALAPPDATA%/wdauto/startup.log` for Chrome, or to
`%LOCALAPPDATA%/wdauto/edge/startup.log` for Edge. If port 4444 is
already in use after upgrading from an older version, stop the previous
Selenium process before starting the new one.

# Package index

## Drivers and servers

Download the WebDriver that matches the installed browser, and the
Selenium Server used by the default Chrome backend.

- [`get_cd()`](https://tony2015116.github.io/wdauto/reference/get_cd.md)
  : Download a browser WebDriver
- [`get_ss()`](https://tony2015116.github.io/wdauto/reference/get_ss.md)
  : Download Selenium Server

## Service

Start or reuse the managed local service, keep it running at login, and
stop it again.

- [`auto_cs()`](https://tony2015116.github.io/wdauto/reference/auto_cs.md)
  : Start a local WebDriver service
- [`reset_cs()`](https://tony2015116.github.io/wdauto/reference/reset_cs.md)
  : Stop the managed browser driver and remove its login startup entry
